notes: Existing WPF PO-lines grid already keyboard-first (F2/Enter/Tab/Ins/Del/F6/F8, menu access keys, 2px focus ring). Written from the project code before any advise command. Remaining mouse-only paths I expect the change to cover: combo cells (Unit/Warehouse/Status) need F2 + F4/Alt+Down + arrows with no type-to-select; focus is lost after Delete/Undo (arrows stop working until the grid is clicked); the filter box has no Enter-to-grid path; the empty state lands with nothing focused; sorting is header-click only. Budget expectation: low/moderate; navigation (menu+command bar), theme and typography must not change.
